description: Relay for Codex: configure and run native-provider workers as real Codex native children, plus thin external-cli workers (Claude Code, OpenCode, Antigravity). Use when the user wants to connect a custom provider/model, set Base URL/model/API key, or delegate a task with explicit control and review.
short_description: Codex native subagents and external workers
default_prompt: Use $relay-agent as a thin execution layer. When the user names a configured native provider/model, run native status -> dispatch -> Codex spawn_agent -> wait_agent; never send it to relay route/run or an external CLI. Without a named model, inspect ready native profiles and choose the one whose public purpose fits the task; use dispatch --auto for a unique or provider/model-name match, and ask only when candidates remain tied. Configure a native-provider from Base URL + Model ID + API Key (key via stdin only, never on the command line); preserve raw output for Codex review.
